# Deviload 2.10.0

**Watch the music video of the song you are listening to.** A camera button in the player opens the video on its own stage, rising out of the cover and playing in step with the music. Three new themes join Ambient.

- Open a song's music video from the camera button in the player. The video plays without its own sound, follows the song as you pause or seek, and changes with the next song.
- Choose the video quality, up to 1080p, and open the video in full screen. A buffering ring shows while the picture catches up.
- Only the artist's own upload of the same recording is used. When a video has a long intro or a different edit, the cover stays instead of a picture out of step.
- Pick the new Noir, Vinyl or Paper theme. Ambient stays the default.

### Devil Music

The player bar has shortcuts to the mini-player and the phone remote on wide windows. The library sidebar has symbols tinted with the colour of the current cover, clearer labels and its tools gathered in one tray. Player colours follow the theme, and light themes keep a light Now Playing panel.

Music videos are fetched about a minute ahead of what you watch rather than to the end, and reopening the last two videos is instant.

### Deviload

The window can be dragged from anywhere on the top bar that is not a button or a field.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
